batch_label: Fix — Price in full US dollars: `$m` rows converted to `USD` (2026-09-17, sep-17-pass batch 12)
reason: Baird ruling 2026-09-17: Price is always entered in full US dollars with Price currency `USD`. The 29 rows that carry a Price in millions with currency `$m` are multiplied by 1,000,000. A unit conversion, not a new value: preserve_ref keeps each existing Price [ref] and skips the §3.8c gate (QC §4).
